findings.text: Residual two-word ambiguity, pre-existing word order, not introduced or worsened by this correction: 'tên hay mô tả tác nhân' can momentarily parse as 'tên hay' ('a good name', hay as adjective) before 'mô tả tác nhân' forces the coordination reading (hay = 'or'). The 'nào' resolves it on the second pass, so no meaning is lost and no reader is left in a wrong reading; it is materially shallower than the clipped-'có' garden path this round confirms fixed. Suggested one-line fix if a later copy pass touches the line: 'Không có tên tác nhân hay mô tả nào chứa nội dung đó.' keeps 'tên tác nhân' together and removes the 'good name' reading.
